title: Item name Copier
description: Copies items name in your inventory by hovering over the item in your inventory or holding it in your hand and pressing Ctrl+Shift.
body: Item Copier is a basic utility mod that helps in coping any item in your inventory to your clipboard. Simply hover above the desired item or carry it in your hand, then hit Ctrl + Shift keys together, and you will get an immediate copy of that items name.
